description: React component for rendering and interacting with a roadmap editor, including node detail extraction, event handling, and progress updates.

classes.name: RoadmapNodeDetails
classes.description: Type defining details of a roadmap node, including nodeId, nodeType, targetGroup, and optional title.

methods.name: getNodeDetails
methods.description: Extracts node details from an SVG element, returning nodeId, nodeType, targetGroup, and title if available.

methods.name: updateTopicStatus
methods.description: Updates the progress status of a given topic and refreshes progress indicators.
